2025-2026.summary: Hamilton and Beauty and the Beast significantly outperformed their pre-season peer signals, with Hamilton sustaining 93% paid capacity across 26 peer-venue weeks against a 97% pre-season benchmark — a remarkably consistent result. & Juliet underperformed relative to expectations, dropping from a 92% pre-season peer signal to 77% actual peer capacity. Water for Elephants and Suffs, both new to touring, showed solid mid-70s capacity without any pre-season comparison baseline, while Spamalot and Kinky Boots both came in at the low end of the range.
